about: A hydrogen–nitrogen mixture, often called forming gas, gives a protective, mildly reducing atmosphere. It is used in annealing and brazing furnaces, in electronics processing and — in low-hydrogen blends — as a tracer gas for leak detection.
Because it contains hydrogen, handle it as a flammable gas: ventilate, keep ignition sources away and use suitable regulators. Confirm the exact hydrogen percentage you need when ordering.
